title: Community-Service and Worship Attendance
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`prayer:session`), scripture readings (`scripture:reading`), fasting logs (`fasting:log`), gratitude entries (`gratitude:entry`), retreats (`retreat:event`).
app: Spiritual-practice and mindfulness logs — prayer / meditation timers, scripture-reading plans (YouVersion), fasting and gratitude journals, and retreat calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=retreat:event type=gathering
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as attended by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how often you attend a worship service, group, or gathering each month.
value: Community is central to most spiritual practice; a simple count helps you stay connected.
implementation: Ingest attendance events into `index=personal`; count per month.

references.title: Greater Good Science Center — gratitude research

grandmaExplanation: It counts how often you join your worship group or community each month, helping you stay connected.
